desc: 精纺色织斜纹，领结饱满挺括不易褶皱，商务绅士冷调裁缝风
leaf: 男士蓝白条纹精纺色织领带
name: 男士蓝白条纹精纺领带款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表用平整挺括的全幅领带正面一眼抢点击，干净合规无文字。
一秒立住绅士商务利益点，用无脸领口佩戴把领带放进正装语境。
shots.textZone: right panel: one headline plus two short proof labels stacked above a hairline rule

shots.intent: 把旧领带软塌起皱边缘脱线的问题放大，逼出对面挺括色织的渴求。
让目标买家在商务办公场景自我代入，理解领带的真实穿着情境。
微距放大斜纹织法与丝光，用材质做工替代表面口号建立品质感。
shots.textZone: upper band: one short proof label

shots.intent: 用明暗四格棋盘同时交代领结饱满与剑尖立体裁剪，一次讲清做工。
shots.textZone: the two light quadrants each carry one label plus a short sub-label

shots.intent: 用领带轮廓引线加空规格单元替买家排尺寸疑虑，数值留空待真实填写。
shots.textZone: hairline leader lines plus an empty spec table, all values left as blank fields

shots.intent: 在统一无脸领口上并排多色领带让买家直接选款，靠一致性保色准。
shots.textZone: top band: one headline plus three short colour labels

shots.intent: 用无标包装与随附件的真实内容物降风险，绝不编造证书与评分。
shots.textZone: bottom band: three short proof labels

shots.intent: 回到冷调主视觉用按钮空位承接下单动作，只给空指示条不编促销。
shots.textZone: upper headline band plus an empty rounded button at the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: an alternating two-field system across the whole set: a light cool grey-white field #EAEFF3 and a deep slate-blue field #2A3746, with a hazy mid slate-blue #7E9AB4 used only as a sparing third panel; never one continuous full-bleed colour
style.direction: cool sartorial tailoring commerce for a woven necktie
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms only in a single dusty slate #7E9AB4 at 1.5px stroke, square-tipped tie silhouettes and hairline rules; no filled pictograms, no circular markers, no numbered capsules
style.lightingSystem: cool soft daylight studio light, dominant front or side key with a thin rim, low-to-moderate contrast, always a soft contact shadow, colour temperature around 6000K, no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool sartorial tailoring visual system for a woven necktie across the entire image set; fixed palette of light cool grey-white #EAEFF3, deep slate-blue #2A3746, a sparing hazy slate-blue #7E9AB4, and one silver thread accent #C7D0D8; cool tone throughout; an alternating background system of a light grey-white field and a deep slate-blue field, never a single full-bleed colour; cool soft daylight studio light near 6000K with a thin rim and a soft contact shadow; one font family only, modern geometric sans-serif with a clean Chinese sans for callouts and hairline rules; thin-line single-colour pictograms in dusty slate with no filled icons and no numbered capsules; stable repp diagonal-stripe geometry and hex-pinned tie colours, macro reserved for weave, knot and blade tip, no recognisable face and any model cropped neck-down; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no warm cast, no invented fabric content, no membership or QR graphic.
noDrift: no invented fabric content or measurements
no membership badge or QR graphic
style.presentationRules: same repp diagonal-stripe geometry and blade proportions in every shot, stripe direction consistent, tie colours hex-pinned, macro limited to weave knot and blade tip, no recognisable face, model cropped neck-down or replaced by a blank shirt collar
style.surfaceSystem: matte slate-blue plinth #2A3746, cool grey-white paper stock #EAEFF3, and brushed-nickel tie-bar detail in silver #C7D0D8 on macro only; no leather, no wood, no marble, no fabric stage
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for Latin plus a clean Chinese sans for callouts, hairline rules, generous tracking, all rendered measurements and fabric contents left as empty fields
